Canopy prototype — Idyl Wyld Golf Course

Timber and mown ground taken off the NAIP chip by texture rather than by colour: both a fairway and an oak stand are vegetated, but a fairway is smooth and a canopy is rough, and that survives the per-chip contrast stretch that makes absolute NDVI useless. The split is Otsu on this chip's own vegetated cells. Separation below about 0.35 means there was only one population and the answer should not be believed.
